column1: # Tagalog adjudicated GOLD — hand-verified standard pronunciations of common words, our convention: shallow
# Latin g2p with word-initial + intervocalic glottal stops [ʔ], ng→ŋ, r→ɾ. The clean quality signal (epitran
# omits the intervocalic ʔ). Word-FINAL glottal stops + phonemic stress are unwritten (lexical) — not encoded here.
